Session date: 2:56 pm on 25 October, 2023
[D15:11] Sam: That's impressive, Evan. It's inspiring to see how you transformed by changing your mindset.
[D15:12] Evan: Thanks, Sam. Letting go of unrealistic expectations was liberating, both physically and mentally.
[D15:13] Sam: You're really doing great, Evan! I want to feel that same sense of freedom.
[D15:14] Evan: Thanks, Sam. Just take it one day at a time. Celebrate small victories.
[D15:15] Sam: Thanks, Evan! Focusing on small wins sounds like a plan. I'll take it one day at a time.
[D15:16] Evan: Exactly! Congrats on every little victory. Keep it up, I'm here for you.
[D15:17] Sam: Your support means everything. Here's to moving forward!
[D15:18] Evan: Anytime, Sam! Let's keep pushing ahead. I'm here to help you. Take care!
Session date: 9:13 pm on 9 November, 2023
[D16:1] Sam: Hey Evan! Hope you're doing good. Got some good news to share - I'm a Weight Watchers coach in my group now! It's a pretty big accomplishment for me, feel really proud.
[D16:2] Evan: Congrats Sam! That's awesome! I'm super proud of you. Becoming a Weight Watchers coach is a big deal. Keep going!
[D16:3] Sam: Thanks, Evan! Appreciate your support. It's been a journey, and being chosen as a coach is a great step in my quest for better health.
[D16:4] Evan: Wow, Sam! You've come such a long way. It's exciting to see what comes next for you in your quest for better health.
[D16:5] Sam: Thanks, Evan! It feels great to see progress. Being a coach will hopefully keep me motivated and help others stay committed too. It's a big challenge, but I'm ready for it!
[D16:6] Evan: That's awesome, Sam! Helping others stay committed and motivated is so rewarding. You really inspire us. Keep up the great work!
[D16:7] Sam: Thanks, Evan! Your kind words mean a lot. It's been a difficult road, but I'm determined to continue making a positive impact.
[D16:8] Evan: Sorry about missing any events, I've had some personal challenges since we last spoke. Still here for you though - do you need any support or want to share anything? Btw look what i got!
[D16:8] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a guitar laying on the floor with a guitar strap
[D16:9] Sam: Hey, it looks so vintage and cool! What model is it? How've you been doing lately? I'm here if you wanna chat.
[D16:10] Evan: It's a 1968 Kustom K-200A vintage guitar and I got it as a gift from a close friend. It's been a tough time for me since we last caught up; I lost my job last month, which has been pretty rough. But I really appreciate your support through all this.
[D16:11] Sam: Sorry to hear about your job, Evan. What happened?
[D16:12] Evan: It's been a bit of a rough patch lately. The company downsized, and I was part of that. I'm currently on the hunt for a new job, which hasn't been easy, but I'm keeping my spirits up and staying hopeful.
[D16:13] Sam: Sorry about your job, Evan. It's tough when it comes out of nowhere, but I'm proud of how you're handling it. Let me know if you need someone to talk to or if I can do anything to help. You'll get through this.
[D16:14] Evan: Thanks, Sam. Your support means a lot. It's been quite a ride, but I really appreciate having someone like you to talk to. I'll definitely reach out if I need anything.
[D16:15] Sam: For sure, Evan! I'm here for ya. Life can be tough sometimes, but we got this. Stay positive and it'll all work out. Just know that I'm here if you need someone to talk to.
[D16:16] Evan: Thanks, Sam. Your kind words and support mean a lot. It's great to have you here. I'm gonna stay positive and keep going. Cheers!
[D16:16] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a person walking on the beach with a surfboard
[D16:17] Sam: Wow, that sunset is stunning! It's so soothing just to see it. Is that a special spot you go to watch sunsets?
[D16:18] Evan: Yeah, it's this peaceful place close to my home. I often go there to relax and unwind.
[D16:19] Sam: That sounds wonderful, Evan! I'd love to check it out with you sometime.
[D16:20] Evan: Oh, I wish I could bring you along. That picture was actually taken last Friday at my favorite spot by the beach. Watching the waves and the sunset colors really helps me find peace, especially during tough times. It's a beautiful reminder of nature's resilience. We should definitely plan to go together someday.
[D16:21] Sam: No worries, Evan. And yes, we should make a plan to go. That photo is just mesmerizing!
[D16:22] Evan: I'm glad you like it! It's a really calming place. Let's make a point to visit it together soon.
[D16:23] Sam: Absolutely, Evan! A trip there sounds like the perfect way to de-stress.
[D16:24] Evan: Awesome, let's do it! Let's plan it for next month, I'm already excited about exploring it together!
Session date: 7:30 pm on 21 November, 2023
[D17:1] Sam: Hey Ev! Long time no chat. How's it going? Hope all is well.
[D17:2] Evan: Hey Sam, good to hear from you! Life's been a wild ride lately. Last week, I had a health scare and had to go to the hospital. They found something suspicious during a check-up, which freaked me out. Thankfully, it was all a misunderstanding, but it made me realize how important it is to keep an eye on my health. How've you been?
[D17:3] Sam: Woah, Evan, that must've been scary! Phew, it was just a misunderstanding. A health scare can really make you re-evaluate what's important. As for me, I've been dealing with some discomfort and it's been limiting my movement. I've been trying to make changes diet-wise, but it can be hard.
[D17:4] Evan: That sucks, Sam. It's tough when our health holds us back. I believe in you – just taking small steps can help. Have you tried any new hobbies recently to take your mind off it?
[D17:5] Sam: Thanks, Evan. I haven't tried much new lately, but I did get this yesterday. It's been my go-to 'feel good' flick. So, you said you had a health scare - how're you now?
[D17:5] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a book with a picture of a man on it
[D17:6] Evan: That movie sounds interesting! I'm doing well now. Doctors said everything is fine, but it taught me the value of life. Just trying to enjoy the moment.
[D17:7] Sam: That's awesome, Evan! Let's make it a habit to appreciate something each day. It really helps us enjoy life more. What do you think?
[D17:8] Evan: Sounds good, Sam! Let's take the time to appreciate the little things in life.
[D17:9] Sam: Thanks for always being there, Evan. It means a lot.
[D17:10] Evan: Sure, Sam. I'm here for you. We gotta stick together, especially now.
[D17:11] Sam: Yeah, Evan. Life can be tough sometimes, but having supportive people like you makes it way easier.
[D17:12] Evan: Yeah, Sam. Tough times are way easier with friends we can rely on. We've got each other!
[D17:12] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a group of people sitting around a fire pit
[D17:13] Sam: Looks like you're having a blast! I was wondering, what do you do to stay fit and healthy?
[D17:14] Evan: That was wild! I stay in shape by hitting the gym and taking my car out for a spin. Gotta keep it up! How are you doing on your fitness goals, Sam?
[D17:15] Sam: Fitness goals have been hard to reach, but hey, that's life!

unconnected to the answer path. Never use true, false or yes as an argument.

for one value. max/min/compare are allowed descriptions but are not executable.

    "atoms": [{"relation": "...", "subject": "...", "object": "?x"}],

invented graph constant.
